pages.text: When little remains beyond stone and gravel, begin with $(item)Flint$(). Shape it into $(item)Sharpen Flint$(), then use the edge to obtain Bloody Flint.$(br2)The following recipes turn that first sacrifice into a handle and a mining tool.

The next step requires living matter. Use $(item)Bone Meal$() to spread $(item)Moss$(), then prepare Moss Blocks and Cobblestone with Moss.$(br2)These materials provide the path toward azaleas and wood.
Azaleas provide the wood needed for two early devices: the $(item)Hand Vacuum$() and the $(l:dust/dust_source)Dust Source$(/l).$(br2)One produces Dust; the other separates what settles.

Suspend the $(l:dust/dust_source)Dust Source$() above a floor that can receive Dust. The configured height determines how far below it will search.$(br)Wait for Dust to settle, then use the $(item)Hand Vacuum$() to collect it.$(br2)This first tool can recover three of the five $(l:dust/basic_dust)Basic Dusts$(/l).
